config.title: AI Engineering Fluency
config.display.compactNumbers.descriptio: Show token counts in compact format using K/M suffixes (e.g. 1.5K, 1.2M). When disabled, full numbers are shown (e.g. 1,500, 1,200,000).
config.display.use24HourTime.description: Show times in 24-hour format (e.g. 14:30). When disabled, 12-hour AM/PM format is used (e.g. 2:30 PM).
config.display.hideAutomaticToolCalls.de: In the Tool Usage view, hide tools marked "auto" (tools Copilot calls automatically, e.g. file reads and searches) so purposeful/intentional tool calls stand out. Disable to show automatic tool calls again.
config.display.statusBar.showTokens.desc: Controls which token counts are shown in the status bar. Token counts are estimated from session log files.
config.display.statusBar.showTokens.enum: Do not show token counts in the status bar
Show the last 30 days (rolling window) token count only
Show the current calendar month's token count only
Show both today's and last 30 days' token counts (default)
Show both today's and current calendar month's token counts
config.display.statusBar.showCost.descri: Controls which estimated costs (in USD) are shown in the status bar. Cost is estimated using GitHub Copilot AI-Credit rates (Usage Based Billing).
config.display.statusBar.showCost.enum.n: Do not show estimated cost in the status bar (default)
config.display.statusBar.showCost.enum.l: Show the last 30 days (rolling window) estimated cost only
config.display.statusBar.showCost.enum.c: Show the current calendar month's estimated cost only
config.display.statusBar.showCost.enum.b: Show both today's and last 30 days' estimated costs
config.display.statusBar.showCost.enum.t: Show both today's and current calendar month's estimated costs
config.display.statusBar.monthlyBudget.d: Monthly AI spend budget in USD. When set above 0, the status bar will change color as you approach the limit: yellow at 75%, orange at 90%, red at 100% or over. Set to 0 to disable budget coloring. Cost is estimated using GitHub Copilot AI-Credit rates.
config.backend.enabled.description: Enable backend sync to an Azure-backed store (default: Azure Storage Tables).
config.backend.backend.description: Backend sync backend. Supports Azure Storage Tables and self-hosted sharing server.
config.backend.backend.enum.storageTable: Azure Storage Tables (requires Azure subscription + RBAC setup)
config.backend.backend.enum.sharingServe: Self-hosted sharing server (configure endpoint URL; authenticates via your existing GitHub session)
config.backend.authMode.description: Authentication mode for backend sync data-plane access. Default is Entra ID RBAC (DefaultAzureCredential). Shared Key uses VS Code SecretStorage and does not sync across devices.
config.backend.datasetId.description: Logical dataset identifier to avoid accidental mixing when sharing a backend.
config.backend.sharingProfile.descriptio: Sharing Profile (single source of truth): off (no cloud sync), soloFull (personal full fidelity), teamAnonymized (no per-user key), teamPseudonymous (stable per-user key), teamIdentified (explicit identity).
config.backend.userId.description: Optional user identifier to enable team-wide reporting with per-user filtering. Empty disables the user dimension.
config.backend.shareWithTeam.description: Explicit consent flag. When false, no per-user identifier is written to the backend store.
config.backend.shareWorkspaceMachineName: When team sharing is enabled, also write workspace and machine display names to the backend store (may contain sensitive information).
config.backend.shareConsentAt.descriptio: ISO timestamp when team sharing was enabled (consent recorded).
config.backend.userIdentityMode.descript: How the per-user dimension is derived when team sharing is enabled. pseudonymous hashes Entra claims scoped to datasetId; teamAlias uses backend.userId (validated); entraObjectId stores a GUID (advanced).
config.backend.userIdMode.description: How the user identifier is intended to be used. 'alias' is recommended; 'custom' may contain personal data (PII).
config.backend.subscriptionId.descriptio: Azure subscription ID used for provisioning (wizard-managed).
config.backend.resourceGroup.description: Azure resource group name for the Storage account (wizard-managed).
config.backend.storageAccount.descriptio: Azure Storage account name for backend sync (wizard-managed).
config.backend.aggTable.description: Azure Table name for daily rollups.
config.backend.eventsTable.description: Azure Table name for optional raw events (not required for MVP reporting).
config.backend.lookbackDays.description: Default backfill/lookback window (days) for syncing local usage to the backend store.
config.backend.includeMachineBreakdown.d: Include machine dimension in backend rollups. Recommended for correct cross-device convergence.
config.backend.blobUploadEnabled.descrip: Enable uploading session log files to Azure Blob Storage. Files are uploaded with configurable frequency and can be used by GitHub Copilot Coding Agent.
config.backend.blobContainerName.descrip: Name of the Azure Blob Storage container for session log files.
How often to upload session log files to blob storage (in hours). Default is once per day (24 hours).
config.backend.blobCompressFiles.descrip: Compress session log files with gzip before uploading to blob storage to reduce storage costs and bandwidth.
config.backend.sharingServer.enabled.des: Enable syncing to the self-hosted Team Server backend. Can run simultaneously with Azure Storage (backend.enabled). Requires backend.sharingServer.endpointUrl to be configured.
config.backend.sharingServer.endpointUrl: Base URL of the self-hosted sharing server (e.g. https://copilot-sharing.example.com). Authentication is handled automatically via your existing GitHub session — no API key needed.
config.sampleDataDirectory.description: Screenshot/demo mode: when set to a folder path, overrides all session file scanning and returns only .json/.jsonl files from this directory. Leave empty for normal operation.
config.suppressedUnknownTools.descriptio: List of tool names to suppress from the 'Unknown Tools Found' section in the Usage Analysis dashboard. Useful for tools you are testing that don't yet have friendly display names.
config.curation.timeWindowDays.descripti: Number of days to look back when determining which tools are unused for the Tool Curation analysis.
config.curation.timeWindowDays.enum.7: Look back 7 days when determining which tools are unused
config.curation.timeWindowDays.enum.30: Look back 30 days when determining which tools are unused (default)
config.curation.timeWindowDays.enum.90: Look back 90 days when determining which tools are unused
config.toolFamilies.description: Override or extend tool family groupings used in the Tool Output Token Analysis tab. Each entry with an 'id' matching a built-in family replaces that family entirely. Entries with new 'id' values are appended. Leave empty to use the built-in defaults.
config.insights.enabled.description: Enable personalized AI usage insights and nudges in the Usage Analysis dashboard and status bar.
config.insights.toastsEnabled.descriptio: Show occasional toast notifications for high-value insights (e.g. missing copilot-instructions.md, new fluency stage). Respects the cadenceDays limit.
config.insights.cadenceDays.description: Minimum number of days between insight toast notifications.
config.copilotTokenTracker.windsurf.enab: Enable Windsurf session tracking when running inside Windsurf editor.
config.copilotTokenTracker.windsurf.incl: Include detailed Cascade trajectory information in Windsurf session analysis.
config.copilotTokenTracker.windsurf.cach: Cache Windsurf API credentials to reduce authentication overhead. Credentials are automatically invalidated when Windsurf restarts.
